instruction: Use the pinned Desktop workflow only: Revit 2025, Archicad 27 build 6000 or newer, OpenStudio 3.10.0, and EnergyPlus 25.1.0. Starting from init.ifc and workflow_spec.json, run run_revit_stage.ps1, run_archicad_stage.ps1, and run_openstudio_stage.ps1 in exact order. Do not hand-author delivered IFC, OSM, IDF, SQL, JSON, or CSV. Revit must preserve the workshop structural grid, create geometric IfcSpace objects for MAKER-WORKSHOP, OFFICE and TOOL-ROOM, and export stage1.ifc plus revit_handoff.json. Archicad must import stage1.ifc using the supplied IFC4 translator, retain GlobalIds, validate equipment intensity, exposure, second-level space boundaries and energy handoff properties, and export stage2.ifc, archicad_validation_report.json, and archicad_handoff.json keyed by actual IfcSpace GlobalIds. OpenStudio must consume stage2.ifc and the handoff, create separate thermal zones with the handed-off workshop, office and tool-room schedules, loads and outdoor air, forward-translate result.osm to in.idf, and run a real annual EnergyPlus simulation. Deliver all stage artifacts, native_stage_log.json, workflow.osw, result.osm, in.idf, flow_report.json, model_summary.csv, energy_report.csv, run\eplusout.sql, and run\eplusout.err. Preserve EW3B06 and workflow_spec.json tokens. Evaluation parses IFC entities, space geometry, quantities, properties and retained GlobalIds, reconciles Archicad entity counts and handoff values, opens standard EnergyPlus SQLite tables, checks zone areas and nonzero simulated energy, and independently reruns EnergyPlus; hashes, tokens, or self-reported JSON alone do not pass.
